title: Topological Tension as the Residual Curvature Source A Unified Interpretation of Gravitational Memory and Dark Matter Phenomena
content: This work proposes a unified framework where dark matter phenomena are reinterpreted as manifestations of residual curvature fields arising from non-collapsed quantum geometric structures. Grounded in Loop Quantum Gravity, Thermodynamics, Holography, and String Theory, the model introduces the Topological Tension Tensor as a geometric residual shaping gravitational behavior without exotic matter.
